verdict.rationale: Hatchet's docs show declarative workflow triggering via webhooks, event filters (CEL expressions), and cron/scheduled runs, and its DAG-based workflow model with shared concurrency rules across multiple workflows (docs-6) implies coordinated multi-workflow execution from shared triggers. However, there's no explicit worked example or documentation of a single event fanning out to multiple distinct functions/workflows, and no independent hands-on confirmation of this exact pattern. missing for 10: concrete example/doc of one event triggering multiple downstream workflows/functions, independent verification of fan-out behavior.
